notes: Each tournament is read from its Liquipedia page (liquipedia.net/counterstrike). Use the page name from the address, for example https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/ESL/Pro_League/Season_24 is "ESL/Pro League/Season 24".
If you don't know the page name, use "search" with the event's name instead. The page it finds is shown in the Actions log and saved in watcher/state.json under "resolved".
Optional per tournament: "name" to show a different name on the site, and "subpages" to list stage pages by hand (normally found automatically).

Videos come from the links Liquipedia's editors add to each map, usually within a day of the match. Most point at the organisers' archive channels (ESL Archives, BLAST Premier VOD Archive, PGL VOD's).
Tournaments removed from this list disappear from the site on the next run.
